# Advanced Designs and Extensions

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Explain controlled interrupted time series (CITS).
- Compare intervention and control group trends.
- Understand analyses involving multiple facilities.
- Explore advanced time series models.
- Address seasonality and other time-varying factors.

## Introduction

Advanced ITS designs extend the basic approach to more complex evaluations, including studies with comparison groups and multiple facilities.
